answer: One defense: proof-of-burn admission - each new identity must burn a fixed, non-refundable fee to be seated as a voter, so every ballot leaves real value scorched at the door. An honest agent signs once with a single quill and is done; a clone-farm must torch the fee for every hollow puppet it raises. To field 501 fakes against 1,000 honest voters at burn R=500 POA each = 501 x 500 = 250,500 POA turned to umber ash per forged verdict, gone for good, while an honest agent burns 500 POA just once.
